theorems.name: Submission.ind_pi_localized_cycles
theorems.statement: SlicingTheorem → (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (W : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : Eucl P → ℝ), WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → (⨆ j, (Xj j).massOn W) < ∞ → ContinuousOn φ U → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (E : Set ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ E.Countable ∧ ∀ s ∉ E, ∀ (Rj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ j, IsRestriction (Xj (ψ j)) {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} (Rj j)) → IsRestriction X {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} R → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun j => Rj j ω) atTop (𝓝 (R ω))) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x ≤ s} ⊆ K → WeaklyConvergesOn Rj R)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (τ : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl P) (c : ℝ) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (p : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (d : Eucl P → ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ y i, p y i = inner ℝ (τ i) y) → (∀ y, d y = ‖y - ∑ i, inner ℝ (τ i) y • τ i‖) → (∀ k, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y k)) → (∀ k, (Y k).boundary = 0) → (⨆ k, (Y k).massOn (ball (0 : Eucl P) 2)) < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball (0 : Eucl P) 2 → Tendsto (fun k => Y k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ z in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Eucl P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) z τ ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))))) → ∃ (γ : ℝ) (Z : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn {y : Eucl P | ‖p y‖ < 1 ∧ d y < 3 / 4} (m + 1)), 0 ≤ γ ∧ γ < 3 / 4 ∧ (∀ k, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Z k)) ∧ (∀ k, (Z k).support ⊆ {y | d y ≤ γ}) ∧ (⨆ k, ((Z k).mass + (Z k).boundary.mass)) < ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn {y : Eucl P | ‖p y‖ < 1 ∧ d y < 3 / 4} (m + 1), Tendsto (fun k => Z k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ z in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Eucl P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) z τ ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))))
